items.heading: מבאר הרשימות הנשארות אחרי הסתלקות האורות. ואור חוזר היורד בזמן ההסתלקות, ובו י' ענינים: — בעוד שהאורות עולים ומסתלקים, ממשיכים או"ח מלמעלה, ע"י זווגים דהכאה
items.html: *And we must now inform you, by way of another introduction that encompasses all the worlds, namely, concerning the return of the lights to the Emanator. For besides what we clarified elsewhere, that although they ascend and depart, they 1draw from above downward from the Emanator a phase of light called reflected light.

items.heading: אור המסתלק מניח רשימה במקומו
items.html: There is yet another phase, great and of much benefit, namely, that always, although they depart, they do not depart entirely with all their own phases and ascend; rather, they leave over from their force and from their own phase a little illumination below, in the place where they first stood. And this illumination is never uprooted from there for ever and ever, even at the time of their ascent upward. And this illumination is called a 2record, in the secret of “Set me as a seal upon thy heart,” mentioned at the end of Parashat Mishpatim, in the Sava, page 114a.

items.heading: כל אור עליון לתחתון ממנו, הוא ביחס אב אל בן
items.html: And the reason is that the upper lights are to the lower lights in the phase of a father to sons, who always desire to bestow upon them, as we clarified regarding the honouring of father and mother. For one spark from the father is drawn to the son, and it never departs from him. And so is the matter here in the ten Sefirot, for the upper ones leave in the first place a little illumination called a 3record, so that from there illumination will be drawn to the lower ones.

items.heading: בהסתלקות אור הכתר, הניח רשימו במקומו כדי להאיר לחכמה
items.html: And it follows that when Keter [crown] ascends and departs, it leaves 4one record in its place, in that vessel of its own, in order to illuminate for Hochma which is beneath it, after it ascends and departs. And after it has ascended and departed, then 5illumination is drawn to the light of Hochma from that same record which Keter left in its vessel. And although afterwards the light of Hochma too will ascend and depart to the Emanator, nevertheless that record which remained in the vessel of Keter does not depart from it, even after the light of Hochma has ascended to the Emanator.

items.heading: כשנסתלק אור החכמה, הניח רשימה במקומו כדי להאיר לבינה
items.html: And likewise afterwards, when Hochma ascended to the Emanator, it leaves a record in its vessel, to illuminate from it to Bina after it has departed itself. And even after Bina ascends to the Emanator, the record of Hochma does not depart from the vessel of Hochma; and in this way all of them, down to Yesod.

items.heading: מלכות אינה מניחה רשימה
items.html: But the light of 6Malchut, when she departs, does not leave a record in her vessel, since there is no Sefira beneath her to receive from her. And although there are destined to be other worlds beneath her that receive from her, 7she is not of their kind and she has no adhesion with them, as there is adhesion to the ten Sefirot of each and every world in itself.

items.heading: כל הספירות מניחות רשימות במקומן אחר הסתלקותן, חוץ ממלכות
items.html: It follows that all those Sefirot leave a record in their place and in their own vessel when they wish to depart and ascend. Indeed the light of Malchut does not leave a record in her vessel; rather, only from the record that the light of Yesod left in its vessel — from there illumination is drawn to the vessel of Malchut after the departure of her light.

items.heading: לפי שמלכות אינה מניחה רשימה היא נקראת עניה, שאין לה מעצמה כלום
items.html: 8And this is another cause why Malchut is called poor, who has nothing of her own; and she is also called a mirror that does not shine. And the reason is that her vessel, upon her ascent and the departure of the light from her, does not shine at all, for no light whatsoever remained in her, not even in the phase of a record. And even the vitality of that vessel is not from the phase of her own light, but only from the phase of the record that remained in the vessel of Yesod, as above, and from there it gives life to and illuminates in the vessel of Malchut. And this is what is said: “who has nothing of her own.”

items.heading: ב' מיני אורות נשארים בכלי אחר ההסתלקות: א) או"ח שהוא דין; ב) הרשימות שהן אור ישר ורחמים.
items.html: Now it has been clarified for us through these two introductions how the vessels of the Sefirot, even at the time of the return of their lights and their departure to the Emanator, nevertheless have in them 9two kinds of light: the first is called reflected light, and it is judgement; and the second is the light that remains in the vessel, called a record, which is direct light, and it is mercy — for there indeed remains there something of the phase of the lights which emerged from above downward in the phase of direct light.

items.heading: אור העב שאינו מסתלק, נעשה כלי, ובו נשארו האו"ח והרשימות
items.html: And it follows that in this world of Akudim, although at this time the work of the vessels has not yet been completed, nevertheless their phases and their existence, from which they came into being — which is 10the coarse light joined with the refined light (as written in its place) — this was already there. And with the return of the refined light upward, the coarse light remained below, and it is the phase of the vessels themselves. And there, in this 20coarse light, which is the phase of the vessels, there the refined lights left the two phases mentioned above: the first, direct light — a record; and the second, reflected light.
